step1_figure.circuit_type: CMOS Two-Stage Op-Amp with Class-AB Output Buffer and Indirect Compensation
step1_figure.description: A high-gain two-stage operational amplifier utilizing a cascode differential amplifier first stage, a push-pull (Class-AB) output buffer second stage biased by floating current source transistors MFCP/MFCN, and indirect feedback compensation connected from the output back to the source of cascode device M2T.

equation.explanation: Product of the first-stage cascode diff-amp gain A1 (approx 500) and the second-stage Class-AB push-pull gain A2 (approx 31.6 V/V).
equation.assumptions: No external resistive load connected to output node.

sky130_expected.calculation: In SKY130 (VDD = 1.8V), with cascode first stage gain A1 ~ 300 to 500 and push-pull stage gain A2 ~ 20 to 35 V/V, total open-loop DC gain AOLDC = 6,000 to 15,000, giving 75 to 84 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Finite channel-length modulation and output conductance in 130nm process reduce intrinsic device gain slightly relative to idealized long-channel models.

equation.explanation: Unity-gain frequency set by the input differential stage transconductance gmn and indirect compensation capacitance Cc = 240 fF.
equation.assumptions: Indirect feedback compensation dominantly sets the single-pole roll-off.

sky130_expected.calculation: With input pair bias current Iss/2 ≈ 15 uA and (W/L) = 50/2, gm ≈ 150 uA/V to 200 uA/V. fun = 180 uA/V / (2 * pi * 240 fF) ≈ 119 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Indirect compensation avoids right-half-plane zero and allows high unity-gain bandwidth with a small 240 fF capacitor.

equation.explanation: Phase margin of the open-loop response at the 0 dB crossover frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Text specifies roughly 70 degrees for Cc = 240 fF. With secondary pole at the output buffer beyond 250 MHz, phase margin remains near 65° to 75°.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Indirect compensation eliminates the right-half plane zero present in standard Miller compensation, ensuring stable >60° phase margin.

output_stage_quiescent_current.description: Quiescent bias current in output push-pull transistors MON and MOP

equation.explanation: Transistors MON (500/2) and MOP (1000/2) are sized 10x larger than nominal reference devices, giving 100 uA quiescent current.
equation.assumptions: Vbias levels from bias circuit correctly establish gate voltages.

sky130_expected.calculation: Nominal branch current is 10 uA. 10x device scaling sets quiescent current to 100 uA through MON and MOP.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Process variations in threshold voltages and mobility in SKY130 create ±30% variation around nominal 100 uA.

total_quiescent_power.description: Total static DC power consumption of the op-amp and bias network

equation.explanation: Sum of currents from VDD: output branch (100 uA) + diff-amp tail (30 uA) + cascode mirror branches (20 uA) + bias block branches (~60 uA).

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current drawn from 1.8 V supply is approximately 220 uA to 260 uA. P_diss = 1.8 V * 240 uA ≈ 432 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Operating from 1.8 V with ~240 uA total current gives ~430 uW quiescent power dissipation.

slew_rate_pos.description: Positive large-signal output slew rate (low-to-high transition)

equation.formula: SR_+ = dVout / dt (rising edge into 1k || 10pF load)
equation.explanation: Maximum rate of change of output voltage when charging the 10 pF load capacitor through MOP.
equation.assumptions: Input pulse from 900 mV to 100 mV (inverting closed-loop gain of -1).

sky130_expected.calculation: Push-pull stage can drive peak currents substantially higher than quiescent 100 uA (up to 300-500 uA peak). Into 10 pF, SR ≈ 400 uA / 10 pF = 40 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Class-AB stage provides high transient sourcing current to charge the 10 pF load rapidly.

slew_rate_neg.description: Negative large-signal output slew rate (high-to-low transition)

equation.explanation: Rate of change of output voltage discharging the 10 pF load and 1k resistor through MON.
equation.assumptions: Input pulse from 100 mV to 900 mV (inverting closed-loop configuration).

sky130_expected.calculation: Discharging 10 pF with NMOS pull-down MON peak current ~400 uA gives SR- ≈ 40 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Class-AB operation provides symmetrical pull-up and pull-down currents.

step3_testbench.description: Complete ngspice testbench for Baker Fig. 24.29 op-amp measuring DC operating point, open-loop gain, unity-gain frequency, phase margin, output quiescent current, and large-signal transient step response with 1k/10pF load.
